# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 19 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 19:4 — five thousand five hundred years — messianic timetable

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "five thousand five hundred years" | Follows standard Vita Adae text |
| LOGOS | "five thousand five hundred years" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "five thousand five hundred years" | Same |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All agree. The number is consistent across manuscripts. No divergence.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of All.

---

## 19:4 — the most loving Christ — divine epithet

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the most loving Christ" | Literal Christus amantissimus |
| LOGOS | "the most loving Christ" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "the most loving Christ" | Same |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All agree. The Latin superlative amantissimus (most loving) is preserved. No divergence.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of All.
